title: Ukichoka Tokyo, nenda Thermae-yu huko Shinjuku

text.🗼 MY SUMMER TRIP TO TOKYO: 🗼 SAFARI YANGU YA MAJIRA YA JOTO TOKYO
text.Hot Summer: Majira ya joto yenye joto kali
text.This is my recommended place for when yo: Hapa ndipo ninapopendekeza uende unapochoka kwenye safari ya Tokyo.
text.I came to Tokyo thinking I would ride a: Nilikuja Tokyo nikifikiri nitaendesha baiskeli kuzunguka jiji kidogo.
Tokyo huwa na joto kali sana wakati wa kiangazi.
text.I lost the energy to ride a bike outside: Niliishiwa nguvu za kuendesha baiskeli nje na kuzunguka.
text.At that time, the place AI recommended t: Wakati huo, AI ilinishauri niende Thermae-yu huko Shinjuku.
text.Really, you can take a bath, and you can: Unaweza kuoga na kupumzika vizuri kabisa.
text.Inside, there are many chairs, sofas, an: Ndani kuna viti, sofa na viti vya kuegemea vingi.
text.You can charge your phone and take many: Unaweza kuchaji simu na kusinzia mara kadhaa; nilipumzika sana.
text.World Cup Rooftop: Kombe la Dunia juu ya paa
text.There are also terrace seats on the roof: Pia kuna viti vya kukaa kwenye baraza la paa.
text.At that time, the 2026 World Cup in Nort: Wakati huo, Kombe la Dunia la 2026 huko Amerika Kaskazini na Kati lilikuwa linaendelea.
text.On the roof, World Cup soccer matches we: Mechi za soka za Kombe la Dunia zilionyeshwa kwa projekta juu ya paa.
text.Also, right in front of Thermae-yu, ther: Pia, kuna ofisi ya Yoshimoto mkabala kabisa na Thermae-yu.
Hilo pia lilikuwa jambo la kufurahisha.
Yoshimoto ni kampuni ya vichekesho ya Japani.
text.When you turn on the TV in Japan, you ca: Ukiwasha TV nchini Japani, unaweza kufikiri kwamba takriban mtu mmoja kati ya watano unaowaona ni wa Yoshimoto.
text.Many famous comedians in Japan belong to: Wachekeshaji wengi maarufu nchini Japani wako chini ya Yoshimoto.
text.With that Yoshimoto office right in fron: Ofisi ya Yoshimoto ikiwa mbele yangu kabisa, nilisisimka kidogo nikifikiri huenda nikamwona mtu wa kwenye TV.
text.And the Yoshimoto office was a building: Ofisi ya Yoshimoto ilikuwa katika jengo lililofanana sana na shule.
text.Thermae-yu is really a place where you c: Thermae-yu ni mahali ambapo unaweza kutumia muda upendavyo.
text.I stayed about 6 hours, and it was still: Nilikaa takriban saa sita na bado nililipa karibu yen 3,000 tu.
text.I could take a bath and sleep a lot, and: Niliweza kuoga na kulala sana; palikuwa mahali pazuri sana.
text.I relaxed so much that I took a bath 2 t: Nilipumzika sana kiasi kwamba nilioga mara mbili hapa.
text.I took a bath, slept, ate, and took a ba: Nilioga, nikalala, nikala, kisha nikaoga tena.
text.If you get tired in Tokyo, a bath place: Uchokapo Tokyo, sehemu ya kuogea kama hii inaweza kuwa chaguo zuri.
